caption: The drawing depicts two views of a small, box-shaped building with a gabled roof and a decorative cupola on top. The building is depicted in dark brown, green, and yellowish tones, with the roof and architectural details such as windows and doors rendered in darker colors. The front view, on the left, shows a set of steps leading to double doors with glass panes, above which the words "STATE BANK" are visible in raised letters. The front facade has arched windows on either side of the door, with decorative brickwork surrounding the windows and door. The roof features two small dormer windows and is bordered by a decorative trim. The side/rear view, on the right, shows similar arched windows on one wall but lacks the steps and entrance features. Both views show the building resting on a base with vertical ridges, and the cupola on the roof is topped with a round finial. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
title: State Bank #2
